title: [Decision] Field changes are recorded but not shown unless an object opts in: who decides a record shows its change history?
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「等我决定的都要立卡，并且从业务的角度给我具体解释和我沟通」 (2026-11-04). Measured by the seat on `main` `63b86b385d`, on the example CRM unless noted. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## The question

A manager asks who changed a deal's amount and from what. The platform has already recorded it, yet the record's 动态 shows only "更新了 商机…：赢单概率 (%)", with no old or new value. The values appear only if the object declares `enable.trackHistory: true`, and most authors will not know to.

Governing text: `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:236` (`trackHistory` is an opt-in flag) and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:2375-2380`.

## Measured

- `sys_audit_log` held the old and new values for a probability change from 70 to 75 (reviewer's reading; the seat read the gate in code).
- `examples/app-crm` declares no `enable` on its objects. `examples/app-showcase` and `app-todo` set it on some.
- The 动态 tab offers a 变更 filter even when no changes can appear.

## Options

- **A. Example first:** the CRM example opens it on its four main objects, the 变更 filter hides when history is off, and the flag stays opt-in.
- **B. Default on:** every business object shows history unless it opts out.
- **C. Leave it.**

## Recommendation: A

## 四轴分析

**实际业务需求。** 「谁把金额从多少改成多少」是销售管理几乎每天的问题，也是出错后追责的依据。不开时只能找管理员查审计表，运营往往不知道有这张表。

**项目长远合理性。** B 对用户最省事，但改变所有存量对象的行为，也要先确认存储量、隐私和字段权限（看不到的字段不能出现在历史里）。A 先让示例示范正确做法，B 留到确认这些之后。

**防 AI 写错。** AI 照着示例写应用，示例开了它就会开。隐藏无效的 变更 筛选，也去掉一个看起来能用实际没内容的入口。

**创业阶段不扩散。** A 只改示例和一个显示条件。B 影响面大，不适合现在做。

| 棱 | A | B | C |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 业务 | 中 | 强 | 弱 |
| 长远 | 中 | 强 | 弱 |
| 防错 | 强 | 中 | 弱 |
| 不扩散 | 强 | 弱 | 强 |

## Not measured

The cost of B on storage and read speed, and whether history honours field-level read rules.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "trackHistory !== true" origin/main -- ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`
